definitions.explanation: The surrounding text or situation that gives meaning to a particular word, phrase, or passage. Also used more broadly for the background circumstances that frame a discussion or event.

examples.japanese: {文脈|ぶんみゃく}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{推測|すいそく}する→推測する：17957_suisokusuru⟧。
examples.english: I infer the meaning from context.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{文脈|ぶんみゃく}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The meaning of this word changes depending on the context.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴史的|れきしてき}→歴史的：05671_rekishiteki⟧な{文脈|ぶんみゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{理解|りかい}しない→理解する：06059_rikaisuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{真意|しんい}→真意：13699_shini⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{読|よ}み{取|と}れない→読み取る：04602_yomitoru⟧。
examples.english: Without understanding the historical context, you cannot grasp the true meaning of this work.

notes:
USAGE:
{文脈|ぶんみゃく} literally combines ⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧ (text) and ⟦{脈|みゃく}→脈：05247_myaku⟧ (vein/flow), suggesting the flow or thread running through a text. While originally a linguistic term, it is now widely used in everyday speech for any kind of context — historical, social, or conversational.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {文脈|ぶんみゃく}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧: to judge from context
- {文脈|ぶんみゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read the context
- {文脈|ぶんみゃく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沿|そ}って→沿う：13279_sou⟧: in line with the context
- ⟦{歴史的|れきしてき}→歴史的：05671_rekishiteki⟧{文脈|ぶんみゃく}: historical context

SIMILAR WORDS:
- コンテキスト: context (loanword, often used in IT/technical fields)
- ⟦{前後|ぜんご}→前後：04042_zengo⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: surrounding context (more literal)
- ⟦{背景|はいけい}→背景：28348_haikei⟧: background (broader, not necessarily textual)
